kuru-flow.auth: JWT minted without signup from any address (1 request/second)
kuru-flow.use: quote cross-check only, not an execution route

BTC.cap: one position at a time across cbBTC and WBTC (one BTC exposure)

assets.name: Wrapped Ether
assets.issuer: Wormhole NTT token, issued through MonadBridge (2/2 NTT)
assets.upgradeability: Upgradeable: ERC-1967 proxy (177-byte proxy, implementation 0x7e0aF7c98CBf443B345d718c3787F3f86ADbC51D). Minting is controlled by the NTT manager 0x36878C6FCa7e0E8a88F90dc410CfBBcA5B695C95.
assets.transfer: Standard ERC-20 (18 decimals). Real buy and sell balances matched the quotes: no transfer fee observed.
assets.why: Buy and sell both quote on PancakeSwap v3 0.05% with a 0.10% round trip from 0.3 to 30 MON. Real mainnet entry, partial sell, close and withdraw: see docs/momentum.md.
disableIf: round trip at the intended size above 1.0%
pool price more than 3% away from the USDC cross-rate
token paused or proxy upgraded since verification

assets.name: Wrapped Bitcoin
assets.upgradeability: Not a proxy (13.7 kB contract). Owner 0xccaE7718e4fbdfaB49dB96E6D7c47D825D78fa07 controls the OFT peers (bridge configuration).
assets.transfer: Standard ERC-20 (8 decimals). 1 unit is about 0.04 MON, so very small swaps lose a lot to rounding.
assets.why: Enabled from 10 MON per entry: round trip 0.54% at 10 MON, but 7.5% at 1 MON and 23% at 0.3 MON (8-decimal rounding), so smaller entries are refused. Preferred over cbBTC for BTC exposure.
disableIf: round trip at the entry size above the owner max cost (1.0% at most)
pool price more than the limit away from the USDC cross-rate

assets.name: Coinbase Wrapped BTC
assets.upgradeability: Upgradeable: ERC-1967 transparent proxy (admin 0x035b83fdb45e155eb72121a414ee2f1356be51a4, implementation 0xd1611e6e93ec512bfbd2b6428a26c463c1dce6f9). Owner 0x0c43bb1A15A1FF1CbDdFF2B8F9518C1B0d3B17E2. Pausable.
assets.transfer: Standard ERC-20 (8 decimals), pausable by the issuer.
assets.why: Enabled from 10 MON per entry (0.72% round trip at 10 MON, 7.3% at 1 MON). Same BTC exposure as WBTC: one or the other, WBTC when both qualify.
disableIf: round trip at the entry size above the owner max cost (1.0% at most)
pool price more than the limit away from the USDC cross-rate

assets.name: Wrapped SOL (Wormhole)
assets.upgradeability: Upgradeable: beacon proxy; beacon 0x0B2719cdA2F10595369e6673ceA3Ee2EDFa13BA7 is also the owner (Wormhole token bridge).
otherPools: pancake-v3 0.05% and 0.01% pools exist but are empty

referencePrice.how: none: the PancakeSwap 0.05% (0x0af424D2AC855684b5A14094AA88FbD5b75d140F) and Uniswap 0.30% (0x1B8Da2180B79397760ecCea97f9471CD24fC85c3) SOL/USDC pools have zero liquidity (checked 2026-10-19)

assets.why: Enabled, but the only pool (PancakeSwap v3 0.25%) holds about 3 MON, so the round trip rises with size (1.2% at 0.01 MON, 6.6% at 0.1 MON, 87% at 10 MON) and no USDC price exists to check against. Every entry is refused by the cost check and the reference check until liquidity arrives.
disableIf: round trip at the entry size above the owner max cost (1.0% at most)
no USDC reference price (entry refused while missing)

excluded: Liquid staking and restaking tokens (wstETH, weETH, ezETH, rETH, LBTC, SolvBTC, xSolvBTC, BTC.b)
Any token not on the Monad docs tokens page
enabledAt: 2026-10-19 (t375u: WBTC, cbBTC and SOL enabled for manual and keeper entries; every entry still has to pass the fresh-quote cost check)
